name: moai-lang-kotlin
description: Kotlin 2.0+ (K2), Ktor 3.0, Exposed 0.55, Spring Boot/WebFlux, Compose Multiplatform; server, Android, multiplatform, Java interoperability.
user-invocable: false
tags: [kotlin, ktor, coroutines, compose, android, multiplatform]
context7-libraries: "/ktorio/ktor, /jetbrains/compose-multiplatform, /jetbrains/exposed"
related-skills: "moai-lang-java, moai-lang-swift"
Auto-trigger: `.kt`, `.kts`, `build.gradle.kts`, `settings.gradle.kts`.

Patterns: Coroutines: coroutineScope/async/await for parallel work; Flow with emit, delay, flowOn; Use Dispatchers.IO for blocking operations. Avoid runBlocking in suspend contexts. Model results with generic sealed interfaces, data-class success, data-object Loading; validate value classes with init/require. Ktor: embeddedServer(Netty, port, host), Koin, Authentication/JWT, routing, ContentNegotiation/json, start(wait = true); post/call.receive, authenticate, get/call.parameters, call.respond. Exposed: LongIdTable, columns/index/defaults; LongEntity/LongEntityClass, toModel; dbQuery/newSuspendedTransaction with IO; findById, Entity.new. WebFlux: annotated suspend endpoints, Flow/map, ResponseEntity, validation. Compose: collectAsState; sealed Loading/Success/Error; clickable full-width Cards, Rows, clipped CircleShape AsyncImage, Columns, MaterialTheme typography. Tests: JUnit 5, MockK, Kotest, Turbine; runTest, coEvery/coAnswers, toList, assert results. Gradle: kotlin("jvm"), ko
